cli.help:
Launch: meditor [FILE|DIRECTORY]
        meditor --gui [--workspace DIR] [--open FILE]
meditor 0.0.1
Usage: meditor --cli <command> [--workspace DIR] [--params JSON] [--format json]
       meditor --cli serve --stdio [--workspace DIR]

Use capabilities to list commands. Commands share the GUI application core.
Tool execution requires --trust or an explicit workspace.trust request.
Document edits require the current revision. serve retains documents and tasks.
--tool-root DIR selects a complete local tool payload for development.
settings.get and settings.update manage local preferences.
--settings-file FILE selects an explicit preferences store.
--data-root DIR selects application data and managed tool homes.
--portable keeps data inside the executable or portable-marker directory.
--language TAG overrides this invocation's human-facing language (en/zh/auto).
Command groups: workspace, document, task, language, modules, project, package, toolchain, environment, settings.
Example: meditor --cli workspace status --format json. Dotted API names also work.
Use -- before a GUI path beginning with a dash.
